title: God's Strength in Weakness
definition: God's strength in weakness means that God's power is often displayed most clearly through human limitations, struggles, suffering, and dependence upon Him.
summary: God is not limited by human weakness and often displays His grace through it.
christFocus: Jesus demonstrated perfect dependence upon the Father and teaches believers that His grace is sufficient in every weakness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The world celebrates self-sufficiency, strength, and personal achievement. Scripture often reveals a different pattern. God repeatedly uses people who recognize their weakness and depend upon Him. Weakness does not disqualify believers from usefulness; it often becomes the very place where God's grace and power are most visible. When believers acknowledge their need, they position themselves to experience God's sustaining strength.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel discouraged because of physical limitations, emotional struggles, disabilities, past failures, or personal weaknesses. Understanding this doctrine helps believers see that God is not limited by what limits them.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop measuring your usefulness by worldly standards. Bring your weaknesses honestly before God and ask Him to work through them. Trust that His grace is sufficient for today's challenges and that His strength is made perfect in weakness.
